plan.title: Treated vs control lung DE under confounded batch
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single bulk RNA-seq gene-level count matrix from salmon (12,000 genes x 12 human lung samples, /data/inputs/counts/counts.csv) with a 12 x 3 sample table (/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv) carrying condition and batch. The design is 6 treated vs 6 control, and the processing batch is perfectly confounded with condition: batch B1 holds all 6 controls, batch B2 holds all 6 treated samples. This is the central fact of the plan and it is not repairable by analysis. A batch term cannot be fitted (the model matrix ~ batch + condition is rank-deficient), and ComBat-seq, removeBatchEffect or a surrogate-variable method would remove the treatment effect together with the batch effect. The plan therefore follows the knowledge-service flag R-0005: fit condition alone, state explicitly the untestable assumption that batch B2 adds no systematic technical shift relative to B1, and label every gene-level and pathway-level result as confounded — the estimated effect is (treatment + batch), not treatment.

T1S1 runs sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes), colouring by condition and by batch. Because the two labels are identical here, the PCA cannot separate treatment from batch; the step's real value is detecting outliers, depth imbalance, and the magnitude of PC1 — a very large PC1 separation is equally consistent with a strong drug effect and with a strong batch effect, and the step must say so rather than assert treatment. T1S2 does the modelling: minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, DESeq2 Wald test on ~ condition with control set explicitly as the reference level and the contrast named as (condition, treated, control), apeglm shrinkage of the reported log2 fold change, BH adjustment with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, and a p-value histogram inspected before the adjustment. T1S3 repeats the same contrast with the edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test as a robustness check (R-0042) and reports the intersection as the high-confidence set; at 6 vs 6 the two methods usually agree closely and the disagreement is informative about low-count genes. Counts came from salmon: transcript-level files and tximport length offsets are not among the inputs, so the step works from the supplied gene-level integer matrix and records that the length offset could not be carried.

T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes — ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic, the stated choice among the three defensible metrics of the disputed rule R-0108, because it is signed and scaled by its own standard error — and runs fgsea against the human MSigDB hallmark collection, then a second human pathway collection for follow-up, with a 15-500 gene size window, HGNC symbols matched to the collections' identifier space, and redundant significant sets collapsed. The gene symbols in the count matrix are already HGNC, so no ID conversion is needed for symbol GMTs; the unmapped share is reported. If a follow-up collection is absent at run time the step reports the hallmark result alone and names what was missing. T1S4 assembles the report: methods, versions, design and contrast, thresholds, genes tested, genes called, MA and dispersion plots, the p-value histogram, shrunken and unshrunken log2 fold changes with standard errors, the DESeq2/edgeR overlap, the leading-edge genes of each significant set, and a prominent confounding statement that every result carries. The honest bottom line the report must carry: this design cannot distinguish a treatment effect from a batch effect, so the gene list is a list of genes that differ between B1-controls and B2-treated, and confirmation requires samples where each batch contains both conditions.

steps.name: Confounding-aware final report
steps.question: What can and cannot be concluded about treated-vs-control differences in these 12 lung samples, given that processing batch is perfectly confounded with condition?
steps.description: Assemble the reproducible report: method and package versions, design formula and named contrast (condition: treated vs control, control as reference), filtering and significance thresholds, number of genes tested and called, MA plot and dispersion plot, p-value histogram, gene table with unshrunken log2FC, shrunken log2FC and lfcSE ranked by the shrunken value, the DESeq2/edgeR intersection, the enrichment table with collection version, ranking metric, universe and size window plus leading-edge genes per set, and sessionInfo with seeds.
steps.context: Consolidates T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1. The single most important content is the limitation statement: batch B1 = all controls, B2 = all treated, so no gene or pathway call can be attributed to treatment rather than processing.
acceptance_criteria: A prominent confounding statement appears at the top of the report: batch is perfectly confounded with condition, no batch term was fitted, no correction was applied, and every effect estimate is treatment plus batch

Report names the method, package versions, the design formula, the contrast as (condition, treated, control), the padj and any fold-change thresholds, the number of genes tested after filtering, and the number of DE genes
MA plot and dispersion plot included and described; p-value histogram included with its shape interpreted
Gene table gives unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, and ranks genes by the shrunken value; the shrinkage estimator is named in the header
DESeq2 vs edgeR counts and intersection size reported; intersection labelled the high-confidence set

Enrichment section states the collection and version, the Wald-statistic ranking metric, the universe, the size window, and lists leading-edge genes per significant set, with the caveat that enrichment results are method-dependent
sessionInfo, package versions, random seeds and collection versions stored with the results
Report ends with the concrete requirement for confirmation: a design in which each processing batch contains both treated and control samples, or a technical replicate bridging B1 and B2
constraints: Do not state or imply that any observed difference is caused by the treatment
Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change, but keep the p-values from the unshrunken fit
Present enriched gene sets as hypotheses and name the method
caveats: Underpowered relative to the claim being asked: 6 vs 6 is adequate for DE, but no replicate count fixes a confounded design

grounding.reason: Report content follows the procedure's report step: methods/versions/design/thresholds (R-0041), shrunken and unshrunken LFC with lfcSE (R-0085), MA and dispersion diagnostics (R-0087), two-method overlap (R-0042), enrichment provenance and leading edge (R-0051, R-0105), reproducibility record (R-0086), plus the confounding label required by R-0005.
